pr_title: Fix scores sometimes not being re-standardised correctly
pr_body:
Prereqs:
- [x] https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/10288

Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10144

Splits out into two pathways for determining the max combo, depending on whether the score is a lazer or stable score.

issue_context.title: Standardised score is not 1-million-based
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:**

 When I updated to this version (2020.910.0), I noticed that all of my local scores look less than what were displayed in the previous version. (e.g. ~990k scores now become ~780k). SS a map without any mod and bonus point does not yield a score of 1 million.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

This screenshot shows one of my SS record (without any mod and bonus point). Note that I have `standardised` on in the settings.

![osu_2020-09-11_14-47-49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16000021/92962290-bc265580-f43e-11ea-964d-b75747a8522a.jpg)

**osu!lazer version:** 

2020.910.0
